revise.effect: Only the session's outcome changes, to the one chosen; the earlier ruling stays recorded and the revision is written beside it. notUndone.enrollment_ended: The enrollment is no longer active, and the revision does not reopen it.
notUndone.party_banned: The account ban the earlier ruling ordered stays as it is; the revision does not lift it. It is acted on through its usual path.
notUndone.party_suspended: The account suspension the earlier ruling ordered stays as it is; the revision does not lift it. It is lifted on its usual path.

refused.disputeOpen: This session has an open dispute, which is resolved first, before any revision. Nothing changed.

sessions.title: Enrollments and sessions
sessions.lede: Every enrollment and its sessions as they stand. From here a session not yet settled is cancelled, an enrollment an administrator's decision closed is restored at any time (its slot held for it a while, after that while it stays free), a held slot is released, an outcome nobody disputed is corrected, and a compensation case is opened. Payment status is on the payments page alone.

cancel.title: Cancel session {n}
cancel.effect: The session becomes «Cancelled by admin» with no penalty on either party, and a compensation case opens on the enrollment, or the cancellation joins its open case if there is one.

refused.notScheduled: This session is no longer upcoming: it was settled or cancelled, or it is disputed and its outcome is decided on the disputes page. Nothing changed.
refused.notFound: This session was not found. Nothing changed.

restore.title: Restore the enrollment
restore.until: The slot is held for this enrollment until {when}; after that the restore succeeds while the slot is still free.
restore.effect: The enrollment becomes active again, its remaining sessions are created from the nearest weekly time after the first-session lead, each remedy the closing's case held is offered again, and that case closes with the note «restored». The cancelled sessions stay as they are.

refused.notRestorable: This closing cannot be restored from here. Nothing changed.
refused.windowClosed: The restore window has passed. Nothing changed.
refused.caseClosed: The closing's case was closed, so the enrollment is not restored through it. Nothing changed.
refused.partyRestricted: A party's account is not active, or the teacher's approval does not stand. Nothing changed.
refused.slotInactive: The teacher deactivated this enrollment's weekly slot. Nothing changed.
refused.slotChanged: The teacher changed the weekly slot's day, time or time zone since the enrollment's sessions were created, and the student is not moved to a new time. Nothing changed.
refused.slotTaken: The weekly slot is taken by another student in a week the restore would fill. Nothing changed.
refused.timeTaken: A session the restore would create overlaps a session, an open hold or a reserved make-up time of either party. Nothing changed.
refused.noFreeWeek: No free week was found for a remedy the closing's case held, so the case stays open. Nothing changed.
refused.notFound: This enrollment was not found. Nothing changed.
refused.refunded: This enrollment's payment was refunded through the payment gateway, so it is not restored; the student books anew. Nothing changed.

restore.released: This enrollment's slot was released on {when}, so the restore succeeds while the slot is still free.

release.title: Release the enrollment's slot
release.until: The weekly slot is held for this enrollment until {when}.
release.effect: The weekly slot becomes bookable now, so another student may take it. The release cannot be undone: the enrollment can still be restored after it while the slot stays free, and is refused once someone else takes it.

refused.slotNotHeld: This enrollment's slot is no longer held for it: the hold ended, it was already released, or its closing can no longer be restored. Read the page again. Nothing changed.
refused.notFound: This enrollment was not found. Nothing changed.

end.title: End the enrollment
end.effect: The remaining sessions are cancelled, a compensation case opens for what the student is owed, and the enrollment stays restorable at any time while the case is open; with «Release the slot now», or after the hold, the restore succeeds only while the slot is still free.
end.releaseFinal: A release of the slot cannot be undone: another student may take it, and the restore is refused once someone else has it.
end.reasonLabel: Reason (shown to the student and the teacher)

refused.complaintOpen: A complaint of the teacher's absence is open on this enrollment, so it is not ended directly: decide the complaint on its page. Nothing changed.
